description: Every known vulnerability in one WordPress plugin or theme, by its wordpress.org slug, or in WordPress core, most urgent first, with affected versions and fixes from Wordfence Intelligence and the CVE records. Without a slug, a name such as "Contact Form 7" is matched: a clear match is answered directly and otherwise the candidates are listed. Give a version to learn which entries affect it and the lowest upgrade that clears them.

name.description: The plugin or theme name, when the slug is unknown.

only_affected.description: With version, list only the entries that affect it.

slug.description: The wordpress.org slug, such as contact-form-7. Not needed for core.

version.description: Optional exact version to check, such as 5.8.1.

name: get_wordpress

attribution.description: Wordfence's copyright notice and license, to show with the data.

candidates.description: When the name is ambiguous: slugs to call again with.

wordpress.description: The type, slug and name matched.

title: Look up a WordPress plugin, theme or core
